item.title: RainyLink v1.0: Launching the Network
item.description: I just launched RainyLink v1.0 — my own navlink widget! It's a dynamic way to exchange traffic and support the community. This widget comes in two standard sizes: 88x31 and 176x62, and rotates randomly between all members of the network every 10 seconds. Join the network today!
